title: Can I LOSE to DrawFish?
summary: Reverse-goal game vs DrawFish, a Stockfish variant that always plays the move bringing the evaluation closest to 0.00 (an 'I offer draw' fish). The narrator tries to LOSE (get checkmated). Strategy: gain an advantage by hanging pieces DrawFish won't take (taking would unbalance the eval) and grabbing defended material it won't recapture, simplify to queens+rooks, then try to force a position where DrawFish's only near-0 move is mate. He fails to get himself mated ('apparently not capable').
rules: Opponent DrawFish: evaluates all legal moves with Stockfish and plays the one whose resulting eval is closest to 0.00 (it won't take hanging material if that keeps eval near 0).
Player's goal is reversed: success = DrawFish checkmates you.
win_condition: Get checkmated by DrawFish (narrator did not manage it).
